## messq version

print build information

### Synopsis

Print the version, platform, Go toolchain and commit of this messq binary.

The default output follows the global --output contract: a human line
on a terminal, one JSON document otherwise. Add --remote to also ask
the daemon at --addr for its build and report any skew between the
two binaries.

```
messq version [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  messq version
  messq version --output json | jq .commit
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help     help for version
      --remote   also ask the daemon for its build (2 s budget)
```
